entities.name: 5GSM cause
entities.description: This Information Element is included in messages to indicate the reason for the deletion of one or more non-default QoS rules, QoS flow descriptions or mapped EPS bearer contexts.

entities.name: Reason for deletion
entities.description: Indicates the reason for deletion of non-default QoS rules, QoS flow descriptions, or mapped EPS bearer contexts.

entities.name: Non-default QoS rules
entities.description: QoS rules that are not default, which can be deleted with a reason indicated by the 5GSM cause IE.

entities.name: QoS flow descriptions
entities.description: Descriptions of QoS flows that can be deleted with a reason indicated by the 5GSM cause IE.

entities.name: Mapped EPS bearer contexts
entities.description: EPS bearer contexts mapped to 5GS that can be deleted with a reason indicated by the 5GSM cause IE.

relations.description: The 5GSM cause IE establishes the reason for deletion of QoS-related objects.
The deletion reason applies to non-default QoS rules.
The deletion reason applies to QoS flow descriptions.
The deletion reason applies to mapped EPS bearer contexts.
